cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me sort our letters before the removal van comes. Keep them in date order, please; we shouldn't decide from a random handful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You kept them. I thought you'd want the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Storage isn't ownership of the decisions. We wrote these over ten years. Sit beside me and start with the first envelope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the box. I just can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it sealed and choose a day we'll open it together. Put both our names on it, please. I won't have you doing all this alone either.
